name: clawbound-mobile
description: Bundled offline native shell for Clawbound: The Sunken Vault

scripts.android:prepare: npm run bundle && cap sync android && node ../scripts/configure-native.cjs android && node ../scripts/native-art.cjs android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:prepare && cap open android
scripts.ios:add: npm run bundle && cap add ios && node ../scripts/configure-native.cjs ios
scripts.ios:prepare: npm run bundle && cap sync ios && node ../scripts/configure-native.cjs ios && node ../scripts/native-art.cjs ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:prepare && cap open ios
